snippet.title: [EN] Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok | Meet the Crew: Beatrix
snippet.description:
Introducing Beatrix (Voice: Jennifer Losi), a new playable character coming to Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok, set to launch on July 9, 2026! 

🔗Learn more about Beatrix:
https://relink-ragnarok.granbluefantasy.com/en/characters/beatrix/
